question: Where did security forces launch the joint anti-terror Operation Nader?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Tral**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Operation Nader at Tral.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **joint anti-terror operation** was launched in **Nader area of Tral**, **Awantipora**.

 
 
• 
 
The operation was based on **special intelligence input**.

 
 
• 
 
Forces involved:

 
 
• 
 
**Indian Army**

 
 
• 
 
**Jammu and Kashmir Police**

 
 
• 
 
**CRPF** (Central Reserve Police Force)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The action is part of India’s **ongoing counter-terror efforts**.

 
 
• 
 
It builds on the success of **Operation Sindoor**.
